d: Logan, a former mutant mercenary, lives a peaceful life, void of violence, with his girlfriend Kayla. But, when Kayla is brutally murdered by someone from his past, he decides to seek vengeance.
An unusually talented rat who can cook forms an alliance with a young chef from a famous restaurant in Paris. Soon, their uncommon bond creates chaos.
Cameron Poe, a wrongly convicted parolee, travels in a flight to go home. However, trouble knocks on the door when the flight is hijacked by some dangerous criminals.
After witnessing extreme bloodshed, Knight George decides to forsake war and seek redemption. However, he is forced to get back to his old ways when he sets out to rescue King Edgar's daughter.
